name: RoboX EgoGrasp v0.2
tagline: Gated HF collection of 7,342 iPhone clips; EgoGrasp campaign: 3,711 recordings, 1,036 object classes, 42 contributors, 7.4 h measured.

annotations.format: JSONL per clip under ego_grasp/annotations/{actions,environment,hand_keypoints,object_tracks,people,sensors}; JSON manifests + validation reports
annotations.coverageNote: ego_grasp README (7,697 clips): hand_keypoints 95.6 %, object_tracks 95.5 % (temporal 29.4 %), sensors 99.2 %, actions ~100 %, environment 100 %, people 95.2 %.

narrations.note: Per-clip narration + action phases from the Gemini-assisted pipeline

action_labels.note: Campaign phases: reach, grasp, lift, hold, place, release (actions/)

object_boxes.note: Object tracks with per-frame boxes; mostly AI fallback, 29 % temporal

hand_pose.note: 21-joint hand keypoints for both hands on 95.6 % of clips

body_pose.note: people/ annotations exist; whether they hold body keypoints is unverified

camera_pose.note: ARKit 6-DoF pose, IMU and intrinsics per frame (sensors/, 99.2 %)

depth.note: rgbd_full sensor tier on 4,355 clips; depth frames not confirmed in files

audio_transcript.note: ffprobe: no audio streams in any of 15,587 MP4s

qa_language.note: Spatial-context labels (surface, environment, viewpoint) per clip

samples.caption: EgoGrasp campaign showcase reel (hosted in the open v0.1 sample repo)
